name: Water Pitcher
summary: At Red Cloud Mesa, Water Pitcher carries fresh well water to Camp Narache. Greatmother Hawkwind asks young tauren to bring it back and learn humility, service, and respect for tribal elders.

sections.title: A Lesson in Humility
sections.body: Water Pitcher rests beside the well southeast of Camp Narache. Greatmother Hawkwind asks a novice to fill it and carry it to Chief Hawkwind. The chore tests their character and teaches young braves that no duty is beneath a tribal protector. Tending to their kin’s everyday needs matters as much as bearing a weapon on the hunt.

faq.q: What is the water pitcher used for?
faq.answer: Water Pitcher carries fresh water from the well to Camp Narache. Carrying it across the plains tests a young traveler’s willingness to do everyday work for the tribe.

faq.q: Where do you find the water pitcher?
faq.answer: You find Water Pitcher beside the well southeast of Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa. Greatmother Hawkwind tends to her tasks nearby.

faq.q: Who asks you to fetch the water pitcher?
faq.answer: Greatmother Hawkwind asks young travelers to collect Water Pitcher. Her aging legs make the trek difficult, so she asks eager youths to test their vitality and humility.

faq.q: Who receives the water pitcher once it is filled?
faq.answer: You bring the filled pitcher to Chief Hawkwind at Camp Narache. He sees the deed as proof that its bearer has the heart and dedication to serve the tribe.

angles.text: As a young tauren coming of age on Red Cloud Mesa, carrying Water Pitcher teaches you to honor elders and help your community. Both are foundations of strength.
